title: Research: CK dyadic ladders save 13,770 / 67,146 primitives (no new kappa)
body:
The selected #626 CK programs prepare consecutive dyadic multiples of an unchanged source from scratch. This finite circuit contribution retains coefficient work across **743 varying-magnitude runs / 10,124 additions**, using exact halving/doubling when cheaper than resetting.

**Status: finite complex-supplier circuit improvement / research note; no new kappa.**

| CK scalar program | Selected real primitives | Replacement | Saved |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Forward | 224,938 | 211,168 | 13,770 (6.12%) |
| Backward / inverse-transpose | 224,986 | 157,840 | 67,146 (29.84%) |

All 463 forward runs are in full-frame cleanup; all 280 backward runs are in **zero-frame preconditioning**. Source reads, initialization, shifts, signed target updates and clearing are fully charged. Exact positive prefix envelopes remain unchanged, as do the macro word, target-update order, native frames, helpers and paid child profile. These are circuit counts, not runtime measurements.

### Added evidence and concurrent credit

Credit @ellipsi2's #722 for equal-magnitude sharing. On these same CK runs, changing magnitudes adds **6,012 forward + 12,596 backward** primitives saved beyond an independently recounted equal-only comparator.

Concurrent **#739 by @namredips** published the same scale-reuse mechanism for JP8 forward cleanup while this package was being verified. This submission claims no priority for that mechanism. It adds separately implemented **CK coverage in both orientations**, particularly the backward preconditioning phase, and fresh complete boundary/prefix evidence. The final scan through #767 also found @taizaki69's **#755** (`a1dd9f819102c40e0b5e4a75215cf69ee864f480`), which covers equal-magnitude JP8 reuse in both orientations with #696's copy initialization. That backward-phase extension is credited; no phase-priority claim is made. This package covers CK varying magnitudes under original Horner initialization. No pending patch is imported. #696/#723/#734 single-macro lowering, #750 live-scale relocation and #751 JP8 common-target fan-in are distinct and not combined with these counts.

Only `research/complex-ck-dyadic-ladders/` is added: executable circuits, source pins, complete per-run receipt, proof, two verification implementations, negative controls, attribution and local claim.

### Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-ck-dyadic-ladders/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/complex-ck-dyadic-ladders/check_columns.py
```

Expected final lines:

```text
PASS_CK_DYADIC_LADDERS blocks=743 saved=13770,67146 columns=716+9 controls=13
PASS_CK_LADDER_COLUMNS blocks=743 columns=11610 missing_clear_rejections=743
```

Linux CPython 3.12.14, standard library only. Both complete scalar projections check all **716 live + nine arbitrary private input columns**. A separate flat-vector implementation checks **11,610 local basis cases**, with missing-final-clear rejection in all 743 blocks. Thirteen main controls include endpoint-neutral prefix inflation, sign/order errors, source writes, frame/phase crossing and undercharging. Isolated optimized replay, minimal relocated checkout, alternate gzip packaging, source/receipt corruption controls, output-preservation, selected-record and staged whitespace checks pass.

### Source and scope

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Selected #626: `660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851`; reviewed #622: `f69477f4f6d3c7eb1f740b166881bffed4ffa9f6`. OS assignment seed **36**, complex track, CK selected by parity. No pinned coordination issue existed, so the claim/result are local.

The private-work clearing contract moves to fused-block boundaries. Production-emitter integration and refreshed global invoice/admission remain separate obligations. Full repository verification, cold supplier regeneration, native phase/wrapper regeneration, global admission, Lean and remote CI were not run. All inherited compiler, common-label/mutable-basis realization, hosting, precision/tape/recovery, bit and analytic assumptions remain. The selected exponent is unchanged.

Credit Jeremy Kothe and the #622 contributors, Chafik Boukhalfa's #626 packaging, icekylinx's factory/emitter lineage, DreamingOfClouds, Dugongue, eumemic, Rohan Arun and retained predecessors. Prepared for **@24kHandsome1201 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**. Both verification implementations were written by one AI agent; no independent-human or delegated-agent review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
